item.title: Ashford begins work on a new well, part of $1.6 million project
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala. (WDHN) -- The City of Ashford announced that it has started drilling a new well as part of a $1.6 million infrastructure improvement project. The city did not provide more in-depth details at this time. However, the city is requesting that homeowners and businesses save water temporarily to help keep the system stable.
